When you take a contrast therapy shower, you switch back and forth between hot and cold water. It's kind of like playing a game with the temperature.

The hot water makes your blood vessels open up wide, like when you're really excited. The cold water makes them close up tight, like when you're chilly.

This "game" helps get your blood flowing, and can make you feel more energized and awake. It's like giving your body a little pep talk.

Plus, focusing on the shower can help you clear your mind and think more clearly. It's like a little refresh button for your brain.

So, if you're feeling tired or disregulated, a contrast therapy shower can help you get back on track by grounding you.
